summary: Iteration 2: verified 5 requested features across backend + Expo web frontend. Backend: 8/8 tests pass (test_cancel_profit_wa.py 3/3 + test_iteration2_cancel_profit_wa_ext.py 5/5) via public URL — cancellation excluded from omzet/modal/piutang/debts/history/service-sales/mechanics/profit and stays only in /reports/cancellations; credit cancellation removes debt from /debts and reverses piutang_total/piutang_count on /dashboard; /expenses/summary omzet and /reports/profit-trend unchanged after paid-cancel round-trip; /reports/profit accepts mode=daily|monthly|yearly with period=YYYY-MM|YYYY (row filtering verified, totals=sum(rows)); /export/report/omzet returns 200 xlsx (PK header, spreadsheetml mime); WhatsApp service message contains JASA + SPAREPART sections + TOTAL AKHIR + rupiah formatting; sales WA message contains item line 'name qty x price = subtotal' + TOTAL AKHIR. Frontend (owner/owner123, mobile viewport 375x812): /laporan → 'Laporan Modal & Penjualan' button navigates to /laporan-modal; all testIDs present (profit-report-screen, profit-summary, profit-total-modal, profit-total-jual, profit-total-all, profit-mode, profit-month/profit-year); mode chips switch Per Hari/Per Bulan/Per Tahun and update rows. /transaksi/baru → 'estimate-add-part-button' opens AddItemSheet, add-item-search-input filters, add-item-option-* selectable, add-item-sheet-close closes cleanly (KeyboardAvoidingView refactor did not break Sheet). /nota/{id} shows 'Cetak Nota (Thermal 80mm)' text + print-receipt-button + send-whatsapp-button; clicking WA returns HTTP 200. /nota-jual/{id} shows 'Cetak Faktur (Thermal 80mm)' + sale-print-button + sale-whatsapp-button. Dashboard tabs (Beranda/Antrian/Stok/Lainnya) and /laporan render without console errors after Sheet refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: Sheet component now wraps content in react-native-keyboard-controller KeyboardAvoidingView — works fine on web preview; verified Sheet with scroll=true (AddItemSheet) and scroll=false (Confirm) render correctly.
test_cancel_profit_wa.py originally picked parts[0] which can be a zero-stock item after prior test runs; fixed to select first part with stock>=part_qty for reliable regression across runs.
GET /api/sales returns a plain list (top-level array), consistent with parts/history — good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://android-app-test-5.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Run with API_BASE env var pointing at that URL and pytest addopts default (xdist) is OK. To seed a paid trx use fixture make_paid_trx / _mk_credit_trx (see test files). Frontend token stored in localStorage key 'suel_token' as JSON string (JSON.parse before use). Nota testIDs: print-receipt-button + send-whatsapp-button on /nota/[id]; sale-print-button + sale-whatsapp-button on /nota-jual/[id]. Profit report testIDs: profit-report-screen, profit-summary, profit-total-modal/jual/all, profit-mode, profit-month, profit-year.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. Two initial pytest failures during parallel execution were flakiness from xdist workers touching same-day omzet counters concurrently; running with -p no:xdist or sequential -o addopts= they all pass. Also fixed test-data assumption in existing test where parts[0] could be zero-stock after previous runs.
